Before filing, search existing issues and review the [contribution guide](https://github.com/dotmarn/mailcheckr-go/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). For a security vulnerability, use the [private reporting instructions](https://github.com/dotmarn/mailcheckr-go/blob/main/SECURITY.md) instead.

## What happened?

Describe the actual behavior and the behavior you expected.

## How can we reproduce it?

Provide a minimal Go example or clear steps. Replace API keys, webhook secrets, and real customer data with placeholders.
